Voltage is a normalized, dimensionless proxy. Hyperpolarized/depolarized labels indicate the model's negative/positive regions; they are not calibrated membrane-potential measurements.

FIGURE 1

Development on a supplied tissue scaffold. Both views come from the same learned state; the electrical input writes only to current and conductance controls. Final anatomy is not supplied to the inference engine. This checkpoint learned normal fields; altered anatomical outcomes are exploratory.

LOOK CLOSELY

The electrical map and the visible tissue are two descriptions of one system. The rule stays fixed as the state evolves. A local input changes the model's electrical conditions; the learned dynamics determine what follows.

02 / INSIDE THE MODEL

A shared rule.
A collective pattern.

Every tissue patch applies the same small neural update rule. Its inputs include local state, neighboring signals, and bounded connection memory. Repeated updates produce the larger tissue pattern.

01ReadLocal state & messages
→
02UpdateShared neural rule
→
03RepeatFast & slow tissue state

The model combines neural cellular automata with BDH-inspired edge memory and consolidation. It is a compact synthesis, rather than a reproduction of the Dragon Hatchling language model.

What is learned, and what is supplied?

Training supervises synthetic normal anatomy and physiological fields. At inference, a coarse silhouette, weak signaling cues, and an axis are supplied as the precursor. Eyes and head/tail identity are not present initially. Rates, connection offsets, and memory rules are specified explicitly. The trained pointwise network learns the developmental update.

How does the browser run the Python model?

This page loads the original portable float32 weights and applies an independently implemented recurrent update in a browser worker. The port preserves all 24 cell channels, fast/slow edge state, delayed messages, zero boundaries, and synchronous update buffers. It is checked against the supplied recurrent reference before release.

03 / EVIDENCE & LIMITS

Make the result
inspectable.

A useful experiment makes its assumptions visible. These are the capabilities and limits recorded for the supplied checkpoint.

↗

Normal pattern formation

Learned face-like electrical fields and normal planarian identity fields on synthetic tissue scaffolds.

DEMONSTRATED
○

Alternative anatomy

Persistent two-headed planaria and ectopic eyes were not demonstrated by the tested electrical interventions.

OPEN EXPERIMENT
○

Regeneration

The delivered damage test retained a visible tissue gap. Anatomical regeneration is not established.

OPEN EXPERIMENT

The data are procedural, dimensionless proxies. Grid sites represent tissue patches. These results do not establish biological predictive accuracy or drug-response validity.
